October notes

Your Google profile is your new front door

For most local businesses, the first thing a new customer sees isn’t the website. It’s the Google profile: photos, hours, reviews and a call button. Plenty of people call straight from there and never open the site.

So the profile deserves the same care as the homepage. Up-to-date photos, the right hours and replies to reviews tell people you’re open, active and worth choosing.

Three things to do this month

Add ten new photosReal ones: the place, the team, the work. Skip stock images.
Reply to every reviewThank the good ones, and answer the bad ones calmly and briefly.
Check your hoursIncluding holidays. Wrong hours are the quickest way to lose a customer.

What we shipped

A resort in IndoreNew website, online room booking, and event enquiries that go straight to WhatsApp.
OffPay11,700+ people used it in its first eight weeks, and two in three found it through Google search.
